ideas.pitch: A voice-first autonomous agent built for low-bandwidth environments that conducts preliminary medical intake in local Indian languages and automatically routes cases to nearest public healthcare facilities.
ideas.title: AshaVoice: Multilingual AI Health Agent for Rural Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Agentic AI For Billions track with a voice-first approach targeted at healthcare inclusion, a massive priority for public service delivery.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI workflow that aggregates mandi market rates, monitors weather forecasts, and negotiates fair bulk purchase prices via SMS and voice calls on behalf of smallholder farmers.
ideas.title: KisanAgent: Autonomous Supply Chain Price Negotiator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the agriculture and financial inclusion pillars of the main track while solving a concrete economic problem with measurable impact.

ideas.pitch: A mapping platform for local public welfare fund allocation where every government expenditure request carries a cryptographic seal that citizens can independently verify on a public dashboard.
ideas.title: GovVerify: Cryptographic Public Scheme Transparency Map
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages public accountability and transparency patterns that resonate strongly with judges evaluating governance and social impact.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent multi-agent system that ingests municipal civic complaints from various channels, categorizes infrastructure damage via geo-tagged images, and automatically files structured tickets into government portals.
ideas.title: Sahayak: Autonomous Workflow Agent for Public Grievances
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses squarely on autonomous workflows for public and social services, aligning with the core track description.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, voice-driven AI tutor that teaches digital banking and micro-investment concepts to first-time internet users in regional Indian dialects with zero data latency.
ideas.title: BhashaLearn: Offline-First Multilingual Financial Literacy Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines digital inclusion and financial literacy using multilingual capabilities, hitting multiple evaluation criteria for the billons-scale impact.
